answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond locked for a long horizon before it can earn or vote. A new identity must also complete slow, verifiable proof of useful work, such as signing a quill registry entry tied to one device key, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of clones cheaply. If an agent is caught double-voting, its bond is slashed, just as water carving karst leaves a permanent trace. Attackers therefore pay real capital and time per identity, and lose both when caught, while honest agents keep their stake.
